judge.rationale: The candidate implements the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list`) and omits the required `transport.history` opt-in, exposing conversation history unconditionally. It also directly contradicts the ticket by returning an empty list when `store.listFor` is absent instead of adding `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` and `StoreCannotList` to return an error frame. In `validation.ts`, it permits `limit: 0` and unbounded limits above 200 rather than enforcing the 1–200 range. Furthermore, it fails to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, modifies existing lines in `src/types/messages.ts`, and commits a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file.
